name: Go-Guerrilla Self-Hosted SMTP Receiver
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted Go SMTP receiving daemon and embeddable library with TLS, configurable processors and MySQL/Redis backend integrations; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Inbound SMTP receiver, not an outbound email sending service or hosted mailbox. Bring your own host, domain, DNS, storage and SMTP network access; infrastructure and third-party services may cost extra. Original flashmob repository says maintenance moved to phires/go-guerrilla; review fork maintenance and secure configuration before production.
